Hi Alice,

Thanks again for walking through the network partition last week. Per our call, we'd like to run a short incident "playback" with your SecOps and our SIEM integration partner (Samir) to validate the log/trace handoff from your on-prem enclave into AcmeBank's Splunk cluster. Goal is to:

- Reproduce the event path (edge collector -> forwarder -> SIEM) using the captured data.
- Validate field mappings and timestamps so alerts match the analyst view.
- Confirm tracehook correlation IDs are present end-to-end for slow-path investigations.

I've attached the pcap we captured and a lightweight onboarding checklist for SIEM mapping. Proposed attendees: your SecOps (you + Gloria), our on-prem observability engineer (Diego), and our SIEM partner (Samir).

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Tue 2028-03-05 10:00 — playback + mapping
- Tue 2028-03-05 13:00 — follow-up: adaption plan if mappings differ

Please confirm which slot works (or propose one). Also: any specific retention/audit concerns we should surface to compliance ahead of the replay?

Attachments:
- incident-playback.pcap (pcap, 2.1MB)
- acme-siem-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart

Hi all,

Quick notes ahead of the Tue session based on the pcap and our prior on-prem installs:

- Field mapping: attached is a short tracehook-mapping.md that shows the correlation keys we emit (trace_id, span_id, redwood_request_id, forwarder_conn_id). For Splunk ingestion we recommend HEC events with a top-level "redwood" object, e.g. {
  "time": 167799...,
  "host": "edge-forwarder-01",
  "redwood": {"trace_id":"...","request_id":"..."},
  "message": "..."
}

- Timestamp skew: in this capture we observed up to 420ms drift between the forwarder and the local enclave collector. That is within expected bounds but we should normalize on ingest (Samir: advise on best practices for _time or eventtime precedence).

- Network/egress: for private deployments we recommend TLS mutual auth to your HEC endpoint and a short-lived token per forwarder instance; see checklist for the token rotation cadence.

Action items for the playback session:
- Bring a sample alert spec Gloria wants to validate.
- Samir to confirm index/sourceType and any recommended transforms.
- We'll exercise tracehook propagation end-to-end and capture the rule that would have fired in your environment.

Attachments:
- tracehook-mapping.md (text)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Observability Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tracehook-mapping.md]
